## MEGA DSC (TEACHER RECRUITMENT TEST) – 2025
CALL LETTER FOR CERTIFICATE VERIFICATION

To
HT No.: MDSC0148360
Name: M EKAMBARAM
Address: BATTUKAMAKSHIPURAM VILLAGE, MADIREDDIPALLI POST,
YADAMARI MANDAL, CHITTOOR DISTRICT,
MADIREDDIPALLE, YADAMARI, Chittoor-517422
Contact
No.: 9494209340
Email: meralachinna@gmail.com
***

It is hereby informed that Sri / Smt. / Kumari M EKAMBARAM, S/o /
D/o / W/o Sri M DORASAMI, appeared for Mega DSC - 2025, is hereby
requested to attend for Certificate Verification in person as per the schedule
given below.

Date of certificate 28-Aug-2025

verification:

Venue: ctr_committee_24, S.V.COLLEGE OF
ENGINEERING & TECHNOLOGY, MUTHIREVULA,
CHITTOOR
Time: 9.00 AM

Time: 9.00 AM

Before attending for certificate verification, please upload all relevant
certificates/documents at candidate login (apdsc.apcfss.in)

Further, it is informed that issuance of a call letter for certificate
verification does not confer any right to selection. Attendance at certificate
verification is solely for the purpose of confirming the particulars furnished
in the online application. The final selection of candidates will be subject to
merit, eligibility, reservation, and other prescribed conditions.

If the candidate fails to attend certificate verification, or fails to
produce the required certificates at the time of verification, or if the
certificates are found to be non-genuine or incorrect, such candidates shall
forfeit the right of selection, and the next eligible candidate will be
considered for certificate verification.

List of Original Documents to be Produced:

1. Printout of the Online Application of Mega DSC-2025.
2. SSC or its equivalent certificate.
3. Intermediate or its equivalent certificate.
4. Academic qualification certificates (Degree Or Post-Graduation).
5. Professional qualification certificates (D.Ed./Spl.D.Ed/ B.Ed/Spl.B.Ed /
6. UGDPE / B.P.Ed., etc.).

Scanned with OKEN Scanner
